notes.title: Audio Settings Fix
notes.notes: A quick update for all you Jousters. The audio settings will now function better, with the volume slider no longer resetting after a joust and the mute button staying in the correct position.

notes.title: A Knight's Eyes
notes.notes:
Today's new update brings a new dynamic camera to coincide with the new camera zoom level with the last update. The camera will zoom and change position as the target gets closer, allowing you to focus on your target.

Feedback is always welcome, if the camera proves to be disorientating it can be reworked.

Happy jousting!

notes.title: Gallantry Tourney Update
notes.notes:
Following feedback on the difficulty that new players were facing with Gallantry, due to a combination of slow targeting and a limited vision I’ve created a patch to fix both issues.

From now on the Player will snap to the targeting reticule much faster, combined with being able to use the numbers on your keyboard to use teammates it should be far easier to hit your target.

In combination with this we have also remove the longsightedness from your character, from now on you’ll be able to see far more of the field, making jousting a bit less of a guessing game.

This should make Gallantry much easier for newer players to enjoy, hopefully without decreasing the skill ceiling but as always I’m open to feedback on the forums, reviews, discord or anywhere else you can find me.

notes.title: Quick Patch
notes.notes:
A quick patch to fix an issue where some players were unable to progress the French quests due to an issue introduced in the previous patch.

Please leave a message on the discussions page or in our discord if you run into any further issues and good luck!

notes.title: Post-Launch Update
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Major Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/h1]
[b]Greeting Knights![/b]
We are now just over a month into the launch of Gallantry. Some of you Jousters have made a few suggestions for improvements and we have listened.

[h2]Team Mate Selection[/h2]
The selection screen now allows players to select their preferred team mate by way of key presses.
As the lance is directed by the mouse it can be frustrating clicking on one of your teammates in order to select their skill so instead players may now press the corresponding key to select their skill.
The key strokes correspond to the character position so 1 for your squire, 2 for your smith, 3 for your priest and 4 for your wife.

[h2]Music[/h2]
Music would dynamically change for jousts but the change occurred at the end of the sound track meaning a quick joust might not see the music change for their joust. Now music will change the second you enter a tournament so you can be appropriately revved up.

[h2]Rebalance[/h2]
A lot of the equipment has now been rebalanced so that your preferred load-out will be more effective against all foes. You will still be more effective if you match your equipment to your opponent however.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
A handful of bugs popped up after people got out into the lists and we have made sure to address all of them immediately. There are also a handful that popped up in my own playtime which will be squashed in this patch.

[b]Enjoy and get Jousting![/b]

notes.notes: Come and join Owen, the lead developer of Gallantry, as we begin our journey into the world of the medieval tourney. Play along at home or just watch as we tourney our way through the first Kingdom and meet Gavroche, our squire.
